pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 快乐 (kuàilè) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cake
   B. Happy
   C. Birthday
   D. Plate

2. "I am in the middle of your face and help you breathe." Which word is the answer? (1 mark)
   A. 头 tóu
   B. 鼻子 bízi
   C. 脚 jiǎo
   D. 嘴巴 zuǐba

3. What does 我用耳朵听 mean? (1 mark)
   A. I use my eyes to see
   B. I use my mouth to speak
   C. I use my hands to write
   D. I use my ears to hear

4. Read the pinyin: lǎoshī hǎo! What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. And you?
   B. Hello, teacher!
   C. My name is Xiaoming.
   D. Goodbye!

5. Read the pinyin: jīntiān xīngqīsān. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today is Wednesday.
   B. On Friday, go to the mosque.
   C. On Sunday, go to church.
   D. On Saturday I rest at home.

6. Which sentence means "This is my mother."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是我爸爸。
   B. 这是我妈妈。
   C. 这是我姐姐。
   D. 我爱你。

7. What does 洗手 xǐshǒu mean? (1 mark)
   A. Wash hands
   B. Eat
   C. Clap hands
   D. Brush teeth

8. What does 周 (zhōu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To rest
   B. School
   C. Tomorrow
   D. Week (short form)

9. Fill the blank: 电视在____? (Where is the television?) (1 mark)
   A. 什么
   B. 几
   C. 哪儿
   D. 谁

10. What does 六 (liù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Ten
   C. Eight
   D. Six

11. What does 在 (zài) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Door
   B. Living room
   C. Is at, is in
   D. Kitchen

12. Which weather word means "cloud"? (1 mark)
   A. 风 fēng
   B. 雨 yǔ
   C. 云 yún
   D. 雪 xuě

13. What does 右边 (yòubian) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Things
   B. Right side
   C. Kitchen
   D. Television

14. Fill in the blank: 浴室在花园____。 (beside) (1 mark)
   A. 旁边
   B. 上面
   C. 左边
   D. 下面

15. What does 看 (kàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mouth
   B. To look, to see
   C. To wash hands
   D. Shoulder

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Who is this?" (2 marks)

17. Give two reasons why it is important to place household items in their right places. (2 marks)

18. Write a short text of five sentences saying what you eat for each meal, in Chinese with pinyin. (5 marks)

19. Explain what tone, volume and vocal projection mean when reading aloud. (3 marks)

20. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bathroom is beside the garden." (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Happy
   快乐 (kuàilè) means happy.

2. B — 鼻子 bízi
   The nose is in the middle of the face.

3. D — I use my ears to hear
   耳朵 is ears and 听 is hear.

4. B — Hello, teacher!
   lǎoshī hǎo! is 老师好!, which means "Hello, teacher!".

5. A — Today is Wednesday.
   jīntiān xīngqīsān. is 今天星期三。, which means "Today is Wednesday.".

6. B — 这是我妈妈。
   这是我妈妈。 (zhè shì wǒ māma.) means "This is my mother.".

7. A — Wash hands
   洗 is wash and 手 is hand.

8. D — Week (short form)
   周 (zhōu) means week (short form).

9. C — 哪儿
   哪儿 asks where.

10. D — Six
   六 (liù) means six.

11. C — Is at, is in
   在 (zài) means is at, is in.

12. C — 云 yún
   云 is a cloud.

13. B — Right side
   右边 (yòubian) means right side.

14. A — 旁边
   旁边 is beside.

15. B — To look, to see
   看 (kàn) means to look, to see.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是谁? zhè shì shéi?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: It keeps the house tidy and safe, and it is easier to find things.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

18. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我早饭吃饼,喝茶。我午饭吃米饭和鸡肉。我晚饭吃米饭和菠菜。我喜欢水果。 wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng, hē chá. wǒ wǔfàn chī mǐfàn hé jīròu. wǒ wǎnfàn chī mǐfàn hé bōcài. wǒ xǐhuan shuǐguǒ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence with correct verbs and pinyin.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tone is the rise and fall of each syllable, volume is how loud you speak and projection is sending your voice to the back of the room without shouting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: 浴室在花园旁边。 yùshì zài huāyuán pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.
